subject.title: [Bug]: Slack reaction_added/reaction_removed events never delivered via Socket Mode (multi-account, v2026.3.24)

question: Should maintainers sponsor a live Slack Socket Mode reproduction for this reaction-only zero-envelope report before allowing code changes?
rationale: Source inspection proves handler support, but the reported failure is outside the current unit-test boundary and cannot be separated from Slack delivery, app configuration, api_app_id filtering, or stale socket behavior without live evidence.

options.title: Run live Slack repro
options.body: Use a real multi-account Slack workspace with trace logging to capture whether `reaction_added` envelopes reach Bolt and where they stop.

options.title: Wait for reporter logs
options.body: Keep the issue open but require redacted trace logs, Slack app IDs, and channel/account mapping before implementation work starts.

options.title: Close only with config proof
options.body: Close later only if live evidence shows the Slack app subscription or workspace setup cannot deliver those reaction events to OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Run live Slack repro
recommendation.body: Use a real multi-account Slack workspace with trace logging to capture whether `reaction_added` envelopes reach Bolt and where they stop.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored the named Slack system-event routing fix and is the strongest current routing candidate for deciding whether the remaining gap is transport, filtering, or event handling.
